_comment: Localized machine-translation disclaimer shown at the top of each translated playbook page. Body text only; translate_playbook.py wraps it in the '> [!WARNING]' admonition and the auto-translated-disclaimer marker. 'en' is the canonical source and the fallback for any missing locale. Bump 'version' to force the marker/block to be refreshed on the next run.
